mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(blood_collection), 0) AS bloodCollection, MAX(blood_efficiency) AS bloodEfficiency, MAX(lab_efficiency) AS labEfficiency FROM TR_LABSTAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT time_slot AS timeSlot, NVL(SUM(blood_count), 0) AS bloodCount, NVL(SUM(lab_count), 0) AS labCount FROM TR_LABSTAT_TM WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY time_slot ORDER BY time_slot
